scope: Published Maynard alveolar signature identity and operational scoring audit; no expression analysis

signature.name: Maynard 17-gene alveolar signature
signature.order_relationship: supplement order is reverse of code order; arithmetic mean is order invariant
signature.terminology: Author code labels AT2 differentiation, but exact supplement list is the published combined AT1/AT2 alveolar signature. Biological regeneration is the paper interpretation, not a new validated causal result.

scoring.input: malignant-cell RNA assay counts after ERCC removal and author cell/QC selection
scoring.normalization: Seurat NormalizeData default LogNormalize, scale.factor 10000; natural log1p
scoring.cell_score_formula: mean over all 17 genes of ln(1 + 10000 * count_gene_cell / sum_nonERCC_gene_counts_cell)
scoring.proposed_missing_gene_policy: Require all 17 genes and finite values; fail if any unavailable rather than silently using a shorter signature. This explicit guard is a new protocol choice, not an author missing-gene rule.
scoring.sample_aggregation: NI17 computes arithmetic mean of cell scores within sample for PD heatmap. Patient-level paired contrasts are a new reanalysis specification.
scoring.version_evidence: Paper states Seurat v3; inspected official v3.0.0 and v3.1.0 FetchData sources both default to slot=data. Exact author patch/session lockfile was not found in inspected notebooks.
scoring.source_default_assay: RNA; code creates single RNA assay and inspected chain does not change active assay
scoring.interpretation_limit: Exact historic executable environment and expression reconstruction remain distinct from resolving gene identities and formula.

qc_source_findings.paper_methods_threshold_wording: fewer than 500 genes and 50000 reads excluded; samples with less than 10 total cells filtered. Code strict greater-than rules differ at equality.
qc_source_findings.malignancy: NI03 imports inferCNV_annotation.csv and NI04 subsets inferCNV_annotation==tumor.
qc_source_findings.neo_osi: 03_Merge_in_NeoOsi merges main filtered and neo-osi filtered objects before 03.1; neo-osi is part of the original analysis, not an independent validation cohort.
qc_source_findings.driver_subset_exclusion: NI16 EGFR/ALK comparison explicitly removes sample LT_S41. Full signature scoring NI08 is a separate all-malignant-cell analysis.

remaining_limits: Exact historical Seurat patch and complete executable object provenance not pinned in inspected sources.
Signature was partly assembled from the source state comparisons plus known markers; within-source enrichment is reproduction, not independent validation.
No causal target, clinical efficacy, or cure claim follows from signature identity or expression association.

acquisition.method: Table S2 recovered as complete ZIP entry from streamed supplementary archive and validated using entry byte length and CRC32; workbook opens successfully.
acquisition.raw_archive_retention: local ignored tmp folder only; stable upstream URLs and SHA256 recorded here
acquisition.archive_status: Partial transport only: 45-second and 240-second requests timed out; later longer retry returned HTTP 500. Table S2 entry itself is complete and CRC validated. Complete archive integrity was not claimed.

followup: Matching processed malignant expression and cell/sample joins verified in adjacent seurat-object-audit.json; independent expression results are documented in results/gse292469-alveolar-2026-11-10.
